g.text: SEONGWOO CHOI / IT JOURNAL
What are Claude Skills? Distinguishing official and
community resources in a post about 400 agents
ARTICLE GUIDE · 2026-10-22
Resources bundled in shared posts have
mixed sources
The LinkedIn post shared by the reader
introduces several GitHub repositories at once.
Skills, agents, and plugins are
different units
According to Anthropic’s explanation, a Skill is
a folder containing a SKILL.md file.
Example repositories may not be Skills
ready for immediate installation
[claude-quickstarts](https://github.com/anthropics/claude-quickstarts)
is a collection of examples for building apps
with the Claude API.
Hypothetical example: a customer
inquiry response Skill
The following is a hypothetical example for
explanation.
AI-assisted article guide. Read the article and linked sources for details.
